# Healthcare Quality Indicators

This folder contains topics related to healthcare quality indicators, specifically metrics used to evaluate the safety, efficacy, and standard of care within national clinical databases. Currently, it houses documentation on Indikator 4b, a metric from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) that tracks the proportion of patients on direct oral anticoagulants (DOACs) who receive annual kidney function monitoring. The page details the indicator's methodology, regional performance variations across Denmark, and governance recommendations aimed at bridging the gap between hospital-initiated treatment and long-term primary care monitoring.

## Pages

- [[indikator-4b|Indikator 4b]] — Tracks the annual kidney function monitoring rate for atrial fibrillation patients on DOAC therapy, including regional performance data and AFDK governance recommendations.
